fields.terrain: narrow coastal plain; hilly interior; savanna in east and south
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, diamond, niobium, manganese, uranium, gold, timber, iron ore, hydropower
fields.farm: oil palm fruit, plantains, cassava, sugarcane, yams, taro, vegetables, maize, groundnuts, game meat
fields.exports: crude petroleum, ships, manganese ore, refined petroleum, wood
fields.industries: petroleum extraction and refining; manganese, gold; chemicals, ship repair, food and beverages, textiles, lumbering and plywood, cement
fields.languages: French (official), Fang, Myene, Nzebi, Bapounou/Eschira, Bandjabi
fields.religions: Protestant 46.4% (Revival Church 37%, other Protestant 9.4%), Roman Catholic 29.8%, other Christian 4%, Muslim 10.8%, traditional/animist 1.1%, other 0.9%, none 7% (2019-21 est.)
fields.legal: mixed system of French civil law and customary law
fields.military: 18-24 years of age for voluntary military service; no conscription
